verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents its own recurring scheduling capability: a managed payout schedule that runs automatic payouts on a balance platform and applies to balance accounts. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. However, it covers only payouts and is not a general way to schedule arbitrary jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, user-defined cron-style or recurring triggers beyond payouts, documentation of schedule configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: you can create a managed payout schedule for your balance platform and apply it to balance accounts with the same location and currency
